scope:
Persistent native tag lookup: tag-ten, tag-another-ten, filter-twenty and cell/epoch hierarchy.

Every project/database is disposable. Acquisition metadata is synthetic; actual
MySQL, triggers, Flask routes, derived indexes and each version's save hooks
are used. Native SQL commits are checked immediately; any background recovery
mirror is explicitly flushed before its final oracle. HTTP times include Flask serialization/client JSON decoding, exclude
oracle work, and do not model browser concurrency/rendering. Sequential bundle
times are sums of their separately measured requests. Profiles are separate.

autocomplete_cold_diagnostic.sql: SELECT tag,COUNT(DISTINCT target_kind,target_uuid) AS amount FROM `recording_workspace`.`app_shared_tag_lookup` WHERE project_uuid=%s GROUP BY tag

SELECT picked.tag,a.profile_uuid,a.author_name FROM (SELECT tag,profile_uuid,MAX(CAST(CONCAT(target_kind,'/',target_uuid) AS BINARY)) AS position FROM `recording_workspace`.`app_shared_tag_lookup` WHERE project_uuid=%s AND tag IN (%s,%s,%s) GROUP BY tag,profile_uuid) picked JOIN `recording_workspace`.`shared_annotation` a ON a.project_uuid=%s AND a.profile_uuid=picked.profile_uuid AND a.target_kind=SUBSTRING_INDEX(picked.position,'/',1) AND a.target_uuid=SUBSTRING_INDEX(picked.position,'/',-1)
